questions.q: Why does the party return to the prison in this chapter?
choices: For the marriage of Absalom and the girl in the prison chapel
questions.explain: When Absalom sees them, hope briefly shows in his eyes until Kumalo says gently, 'we are come for the marriage.'

questions.q: How do Absalom and the girl greet each other?
choices: 'Like strangers' — hands held loosely, no words beyond 'Are you in health?'
They refuse to look at each other
questions.explain: They are 'bound in a great constraint.'

questions.q: What does Absalom ask about a possible son?
choices: That he be sent to St Chad's
That he be raised by John
questions.explain: He also asks for the small Post Office savings and mentions a parcel at Germiston.

questions.q: How does Absalom break down as his father must leave?
choices: He sobs, 'I am afraid of the hanging', and clings to his father's knees crying 'You must not leave me'
He says nothing and turns away
questions.explain: Warders have to pull his arms away so Kumalo can go.

questions.q: What does Kumalo do at his brother John's shop that he is ashamed of afterwards?
choices: He lies — telling John a man may have been sent to the shop 'to deceive you. As a friend' — to wound him over Matthew's betrayal of Absalom
questions.explain: John understands the barb — 'My son had two such friends' — and roars 'Out of my shop!', bolting the door.

questions.q: What had Kumalo actually come to say to John?
choices: That power corrupts, that a man who fights for justice must be cleansed and purified, that love is greater than force — 'And none of these things had he done'
That he would testify for John
questions.explain: He is left 'humiliated and ashamed' in the street.

questions.q: What does Jarvis give John Harrison in an envelope at the station?
choices: A cheque for one thousand pounds for the Boys' Club — he would be pleased if it were called the 'Arthur Jarvis Club'
questions.explain: John exclaims, 'Helen of Troy, one thousand pounds!'

questions.q: What news does Msimangu announce at the farewell party at Mrs Lithebe's?
choices: That he is becoming a bishop
That he is retiring into a community, forswearing the world and all possessions — 'the first time that a black man had done such a thing in South Africa'
That he is leaving the church
That he has found Gertrude a job
questions.explain: The guests clap and give thanks.

questions.q: What gift does Msimangu give Kumalo at the gate?
choices: His savings — a Post Office Book in Kumalo's name with over thirty-three pounds in it
questions.explain: 'Do not spoil my pleasure, for I have never had a pleasure like this one.'

questions.q: What does Kumalo discover on the morning they are to leave for Ndotsheni?
choices: That Gertrude is gone — her red dress and white turban left behind, and the little boy still there, but Gertrude vanished
That John has come to say goodbye
questions.explain: The night before, Kumalo had knelt and repented of the lie, and meant to write his brother a letter.
